title: The $600B Question
description: Dynamic line chart showing Hyperscaler CapEx ($350B+) skyrocketing exponentially while Direct Generative AI Software ARR (~$25B) stays comparatively flat. Glowing delta highlight.

title: The Macroeconomic Limit
description: Acemoglu's Task-Based Model callout: AI cost-effectively automates <5% of economic tasks over 10 years, yielding +0.5-1% TFP. Citation: Daron Acemoglu, NBER / Economic Policy.

title: Bubble or Transition?
description: Display headline in Space Grotesk: 'Is this the greatest bubble since 2000, or are we measuring the wrong thing entirely?'

title: The Three Physical Ceilings
description: Tri-node architectural diagram showing the 3 physical bottlenecks: 1. Human Data Depletion, 2. Model Autophagy (MAD), 3. The 1-GW Grid Wall.

title: The 2026-2028 Data Wall
description: Stock of high-quality human text (10^14 tokens) depleted against frontier pre-training compute runs. Source: Epoch AI.

title: Model Autophagy Disorder (MAD)
description: Recursive feedback loop illustration showing distribution tail loss and entropy collapse when models train on synthetic data. Citation: Shumailov et al., Nature (2024).

title: The 1-Gigawatt Energy Wall
description: Power grid map with 1-2 GW data center clusters and nuclear PPAs: Three Mile Island Crane Center (835 MW), Kairos SMRs (500 MW), Talen Energy.

title: The Paradigm Pivot
description: Contrast card: 'Pre-Training Scaling (Brute Force Token Prediction)' vs 'Test-Time Compute (Reasoning Trees & Verification)'.

title: Test-Time Search & PRMs
description: Monte Carlo Tree Search visualization with Process Reward Models (PRMs) scoring reasoning steps and pruning invalid paths. Citation: Brown et al., 'Large Language Monkeys'.

title: The Agentic Shift (SWE-bench)
description: Interactive terminal mockup showing autonomous agent diagnosing an issue, editing codebase, running unit tests, and committing verified fix. SWE-bench leap from 4% to 70%.

title: The Jevons Paradox of Intelligence
description: Visual balance showing falling marginal cost per line of code triggering exponential explosion in total software production and aggregate compute demand.

title: Precision Scaling Laws
description: Graph of FP32 / FP16 down to FP8 / FP4 quantization curves and effective parameter preservation. Citation: Kumar et al., ICLR 2025.

title: Post-Transformer Architectures
description: Comparison of Quadratic Attention O(N^2) memory explosion vs Linear State Space Models (Mamba-2, Recurrent Hybrids) enabling 10M+ context windows.

title: Local Deterministic Verifiers
description: Enterprise architecture diagram: Domain SLM + Local Rule Engine behind firewall delivering zero-hallucination execution.

title: The Multipolar Game Theory Trap
description: Game theory payoff matrix demonstrating why geopolitical competitors cannot unilaterally pause AI adoption.

title: The Real Risk: Epistemic Atrophy
description: Warning on human loss of foundational first-principles knowledge as deep cognitive infrastructure becomes fully automated.

title: The Final Verdict
description: Financial Wrapper Bubble (will burst) vs Electrification of Cognition (irreversible historical shift).

title: Thank You For Watching
description: Clean modern brand end card with Space Grotesk wordmark, subscribe CTA, and links to the full research dossier.
